verdict.rationale: Luma publishes per-generation credit costs by model and resolution (e.g., 360p Draft T2V/I2V 5s = 20 credits) on a credit-based, pay-per-video system, so a marketer can estimate cost before running. The platform also links a Billing Dashboard for tracking spend afterwards. However, evidence shows only static price tables and a dashboard link, not an in-product cost preview at generation time or itemized spend tracking. missing for 10: in-app pre-generation cost estimate shown before running, documented per-generation or per-project spend breakdown in the billing dashboard, dollar-conversion visibility, independent or hands-on corroboration.
